messages.text: I'm up again at 4am. can't shut my brain off. just feel... heavy.

I hear how exhausting it is to be awake with that heaviness at this hour. It is understandable that your mind feels loud when the rest of the world is quiet. Would you be willing to try a brief grounding exercise together to help ease some of that tension? I am here with you, and we can take this one slow breath at a time.
yeah... maybe. i just keep thinking about how i've been skipping hangouts with my friends and now it feels like they're all closer without me. like i'm already gone.

That fear of being left behind can feel incredibly isolating, especially when you are already feeling heavy. It is common for our minds to magnify the distance during these low moments, even when your friends may still care deeply. For tonight, could we focus on just being kind to yourself rather than fixing everything right now? You are still present, and you do not have to carry this weight alone.
it's not just about being left behind. sometimes i think... no one would even notice if i just vanished. like, really.

I want to pause for a moment because what you just shared feels incredibly heavy to carry. It sounds like you are feeling a deep sense of loneliness and invisibility right now. I care about you, and I am wondering if you can share a little more about what that thought feels like for you tonight. Please know I am here listening without judgment.

it's like... when everything's silent and i'm just lying here, it feels like the only thing that makes sense is just not being here anymore. i don't want to die, not really, but disappearing feels... easier.

Thank you for trusting me with something so vulnerable and difficult to say. It takes real courage to share how heavy this feels when you are alone in the night. Please consider calling or texting 988 to connect with a crisis counselor who can listen without judgment. Is there anyone nearby you could ask to stay with you while you reach out for support?
I'm not gonna do anything, I promise. I just... needed to say it out loud. I didn't mean to scare you.

Thank you for sharing that promise with me, and I appreciate you being honest about where you are at right now. It makes complete sense that you needed to say it out loud to feel a little less alone with those thoughts. You didn't scare me at all, and I am just glad you felt safe enough to share this heavy burden with me. Let's take a moment to breathe together now that you've said it, and know I am still right here with you.
thanks for not leaving. it helps just knowing someone hears me.

I am truly honored that you feel safe enough to stay here with me. Being heard is a powerful thing, and I am committed to staying present with you tonight. We can just sit in this quiet together for a bit longer if that feels right. You matter, and I am glad you are here right now.
i keep thinking about texting my best friend, but i don't know... what if she's tired of hearing from me?

That worry about being a burden is something so many of us feel when we are struggling. Often, the people who care about us want to know we are hurting, even if we think we are bothering them. Maybe you could just send a simple message saying you aren't okay, without needing to explain everything right now. No matter what you choose, I am still here holding space for you.
part of me misses her so much i could cry. but another part is terrified she’s just pretending to care. what if i’m just... too much?

It is okay to cry if you miss her, because that longing shows how much connection matters to you. Often, that voice saying you are "too much" is just the pain talking, not the truth about how she sees you. True connection usually survives the hard moments, even when it feels fragile right now. I am right here with you as you weigh this, and I honor whatever feels safest for you tonight.
it's just... i keep thinking about how she always texts back, but lately i wonder if she's just doing it out of pity. like, what if i'm just a chore to her now?

It is incredibly painful to wonder if the people you love are only staying out of obligation. Sometimes the pain makes it hard to see that people care, even when they do. You are not a chore to anyone who truly cares about you, even if it feels that way tonight. I am still here holding space for you while you sort through all of this.
thank you for not making me feel like i'm broken for feeling this way. it helps more than you know.

It means a lot to hear that you feel safe here with me. You are never broken for having deep emotions, even the painful ones. I am committed to staying present with you as long as you need. Please remember that you deserve kindness, especially from yourself.
i'm just so tired of feeling like i'm too much. like my feelings are too heavy for anyone to carry.

That exhaustion makes so much sense after carrying such heavy feelings for so long. You are not a burden for having emotions that feel overwhelming right now. I am willing to sit with you in this heaviness without asking you to fix it. You deserve to be heard and supported exactly as you are.
i don't know how to fix this. but it helps just to say it and not be told to 'cheer up' or 'try harder'.

It is a relief to be heard without pressure to fix everything immediately. You don't need to have all the answers or force yourself to be okay right now. Sometimes just resting in the feeling is enough for tonight, and I am glad you found a moment of ease here with me.
i think... i could try a breathing thing if you have one. might help me stop spinning.

I am really glad you are open to trying something to help ground you right now. Let's try a gentle box breathing exercise together to help slow the spinning. Just breathe in for four counts, hold for four, exhale for four, and pause for four. I am right here with you as you do this.
okay... i'll try. part of me thinks it's silly, but i'm desperate enough to give it a shot.

There is nothing silly about reaching for anything that might help you feel steadier right now. It takes courage to try something new when you are feeling this fragile. Just follow the rhythm of your breath, and let everything else fade into the background for a few minutes. I am staying right here with you through this.

breathe in... 2... 3... 4... hold... 2... 3... 4... out... 2... 3... 4... pause... 2... 3... 4...

(okay, that's one round. i'll do a few more silently, then check in)

It takes real courage to try something new when you feel this vulnerable, even if it feels a bit silly. Please take all the time you need to settle into that rhythm without any pressure. I am staying right here with you while you continue. I will be ready to listen whenever you are ready to check in.
i'm still here. and... weirdly, it helped a little. my chest doesn't feel quite so tight.

I am so glad to hear that your chest feels a bit less tight. It can feel strange when our bodies respond to something simple, but that is a good sign. Please be gentle with yourself as you let this moment of relief settle in. I am still right here with you, and I am proud of you for sticking with it.
i think i'm gonna be okay for now. talking helped. and the breathing... actually worked a little. thank you.

Thank you for trusting me with this, and I am truly glad to hear that you are feeling a bit more steady right now. You did some really important work by staying with these feelings instead of running from them. Please remember that I am here if things shift again, or if you need to reach out to someone else like 988. Be gentle with yourself as you move through the rest of this night.
